semantic_fragments.content: For clause 8.4.4: Maximum allowable residual voltage is 60V. Maximum allowable stored charge when residual voltage exceeds 60V is 45μC. Test covers internal capacitive circuits (accessible capacitors or circuit parts) after de-energizing ME EQUIPMENT.

For clause 8.5.5.2 energy reduction test compliance: E1 must be at least 90% of E2, where E1 is the measured energy delivered to 100Ω load with ME Equipment connected, and E2 is the measured energy delivered to 100Ω load without ME equipment connected. Tests are performed on each of up to 4 PATIENT CONNECTIONS, with the remaining PATIENT CONNECTIONS of the same APPLIED PART connected to earth.

Risk management result tables for clauses 8.5.2.2 (Type B applied parts), 8.5.2.3 (PATIENT Leads), and 8.6.3 (Protective earthing of moving parts) each reference ISO 14971 clauses 5.2, 5.3, 5.4, and 6 (where applicable), requiring document references to the Risk Management File (RMF) including document number and paragraph, along with result remarks and verdict for each clause.
